subject: Life Skills
title: Reading Body Language Cues
description: A micro-lesson that makes Reading Body Language Cues usable.

hook.text: Albert Mehrabian's research found 55% of emotional communication comes from body language alone.

buildup.text: Crossed arms, avoiding eye contact, and turning away signal discomfort even when words say 'I'm fine.'

discovery.text: Clusters matter more than single gestures. One crossed arm could be cold. Crossed arms plus frown is closed off.

twist.text: Mirroring someone's posture builds unconscious rapport. Leaning in slightly signals interest and openness.

climax.text: Watch for mismatches between words and body. When they conflict, the body is usually telling the truth.

punchline.text: Words can lie. Bodies are terrible liars.

quiz.question: What should you focus on when reading body language?
options: Clusters of gestures and word-body mismatches
